evidence.quote: All of this evidence may help explain the sharp drop in consumer spending as household wealth declined and the continued sluggishness of consumer spending even as asset values have recovered.

imply that some of the effects of recent economic turmoil may result in a longer period of economic adjustment than has been the case in past recessions, as fundamental attitudes appear to have shifted.
In addition, there appears to be an asymmetric reaction to wealth shocks that could be a factor in the slow recovery of spending.
that business credit was hard to obtain even for good borrowers.
